agents.name: Analysis Gap Hunter
agents.summary: The analysis identified several critical omissions in the migration plan, including undocumented conditional execution paths, missing inter-class dependencies, and incomplete documentation of file modifications. These gaps could lead to issues during the actual migration process if not addressed.

agents.name: Complexity Deflator
agents.summary: The migration plan for the cache module overstates the complexity of several operations that have direct, simple equivalents in Ansible. The Chef cookbook functionality can be implemented using standard Ansible modules like package, service, file, template, and lineinfile without requiring any custom handling or complex solutions.
